criteria: shape: N+1 days, 1-3 moments each in 오전/오후/저녁 order, short moments, Korean summary
photos_once: no photo used twice on the page
season_photos: no destination photo dated outside the trip's season
daylight: no daylight sight in the evening when the sun sets before 18:00, no open-air evening in the cold season
credits: every destination photo on the page has its licence and source
jsonld: one TouristTrip item per day
check_items: a bounded number of [확인 필요] notes
destination_photos: at least one credited destination photo placed
